exports: apply_missing_policy(df, flag_cols, num_medians, cat_modes, for_linear_model=False) -> pd.DataFrame

schema.TRAIN_SCHEMA: dict[str,str - 28 columns with exact dtype strings]
schema.scoring_split_order: sort by abs(DAYS_ID_PUBLISH) desc, abs(DAYS_REGISTRATION) desc, SK_ID_CURR asc, then positional 60/10/10/20 gives train=oldest -> test=newest
schema.app_test_adv.pkl: dict with keys adv_train and adv_val; each DataFrame excludes TARGET, includes ADV_LABEL, AMT_INCOME_TOTAL_CAPPED, DAYS_EMPLOYED_ANOM, and matches the non-label application column order
schema.income_cap.joblib: float scalar - 99th percentile of train AMT_INCOME_TOTAL
schema.processed_artifact_manifest.json: authoritative processed provenance manifest with split summaries, fingerprints, schema hashes, income_cap, adversarial metadata, and processed_manifest_fingerprint

envVars.DATA_RAW_DIR: str - path to raw CSVs, default data/raw/
envVars.DATA_PROCESSED_DIR: str - path for pkl output, default data/processed/
envVars.EDA_PLOTS_DIR: str - path for PNG output, default notebooks/eda_plots/
